title: An html template's body is not a region.
text: ``html`…` `` (`rule:core-classes/html-template`) is markup written in expression position, and the rule names it a region on the same terms. The lexer frames one — [`TokenKind::HtmlTemplateOpen`] to [`TokenKind::HtmlTemplateClose`] — so what is left is one more arm of the filter below, which reports [`TokenKind::InlineHtml`] alone, rather than a second mechanism, with the template's two kinds of hole cut out of the region the way a `<?nvs` block is: [`TokenKind::ComplexInterpOpen`] to [`TokenKind::ComplexInterpClose`] and [`TokenKind::HtmlTemplateEchoOpen`] to [`TokenKind::HtmlTemplateEchoClose`].
